'''Katchan''' was a [[Planet/Legends|world]] that was located on the edge the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].

The royal family of Katchan owned an [[A9G-series Data Storage Unit]], until it was stolen by [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]].
